name: Southern Equipment Distributors
old_description: We are the leading provider of ice cream machines and frozen margarita machines in Memphis, TN.
about:
Southern Equipment Distributors, headquartered in Collierville, Tennessee, was founded in 1929. The company operates as a distributor of commercial food service equipment, with a focus on ice cream and frozen beverage machines for the Memphis metropolitan area. Over its nine-decade history, it has established a reputation as a local supplier for specialized frozen dessert and beverage equipment.

The firm supplies a range of commercial ice cream machines and frozen margarita machines, offering equipment options suited to various service models. It provides installation services and post-sale support, along with consultation to match equipment to menu requirements and customer volume. The company’s product lineup includes high-demand margarita machines designed to speed service during peak hours.

Its customer base includes restaurants, bars, and commercial kitchens throughout the Memphis region. The company positions itself as a local partner for food service operators seeking specialized frozen dessert and beverage equipment, emphasizing compliance with industry standards.

Southern Equipment Distributors emphasizes personalized service, straightforward advice, and responsive support, distinguishing itself from larger, out-of-state suppliers. The company’s approach is built on experience and a commitment to honest guidance tailored to each client’s operational needs, offering a level of responsiveness that distant providers cannot match.
